hooks.name: Sync Jira Issue Status
hooks.description: Reminds to update Jira issue status after completing a spec task

action.prompt:
After completing this task, check if there's a Jira issue associated with the work (look for MINI-XX references in branch name, commit messages, or task description). If found:
1. Transition the Jira issue to the appropriate status (In Review if PR was created, Done if merged)
2. Add a comment on the Jira issue summarizing what was implemented

Use the mcp-atlassian tools (jira_transition_issue, jira_add_comment) to update Jira. If no Jira issue is associated, skip this step silently.
